sermons.title: Seek ye First 2
sermons.speaker: Pastor Oluwaseun Fortune-Ibrahim
sermons.notes: Fasting is beyond a religious ritual but a spiritual devotion empowering the space and the race set ahead for a true believer. It is the humbling of the soul and surrendering of self to the Lord for strength and a deeper relationship.

sermons.title: Shattering The Norm
sermons.speaker: Pastor Tomiwa Oluyen
sermons.notes: Transitioning from labor to favor. Understanding the prophetic alignment and positioning your heart for the outpouring of dynamic instructions and divine wisdom.

devotionals.title: Starts With Putting God First
devotionals.keyPoint: Restoration starts with placing God at the absolute center of your daily operations.
devotionals.writeup: I keep my eyes always on the Lord. With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken. Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure. Daily devotion means seeking his face before executing your strategic plans.

devotionals.title: Getting Rid Of The Old Wine Skin
devotionals.keyPoint: Embracing new strategies for the new season.
devotionals.writeup: Neither do people pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst; the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved. Align your mindset, tools, and circles with where God is leading you today.

testimonies.name: Brother Afolabi
testimonies.title: Supernatural Business Growth
testimonies.content: Since anchoring my business under the declarations for Year 2026, I have experienced unprecedented growth. A contract that had been locked for three years was signed within 12 days of our spiritual exercise. God indeed honors his word in The HAvEN Nation!

testimonies.name: Sister Suzan
testimonies.title: Complete Deliverance and Restoration
testimonies.content: I attended the Healing & Miracle service in May carrying severe joint pain. During the prayers, Pastor Tomiwa gave a word about chronic pain being rolled away. Instantly, the stiffness vanished. I can jump, run, and praise without any distress!
